The Beijing Higher People's Court held a final trial hearing in September 2021. In December 2020, Intel filed a third invalidation request on the '457 patent with the CNIPA. Intel filed a complaint in December 2021 with the Beijing IP Court challenging the September 2021 CNIPA ruling.
